title: About
sections:
Hi, I'm Morgan

ICF-certified coach, 9 years in, 400+ client sessions.

I spent a decade in corporate operations, doing everything "right" and feeling more disconnected every year — training as a coach was how I found my way back to something that felt true. I'm ICF-certified (PCC level) and have walked alongside 400+ clients since 2017.

My style is warm and unhurried: I'll ask the question you're avoiding, and I'll hold space for you to actually hear your own answer.
